setupMeter.prefix_with_all_guards_and_work:
def setupMeter (T S : Tree) (X Y : List Nat) (p : RMAF.Vertex) : Measured (Option Setup) :=
  bump ((nodupTreeMeter T).work+1) <|
  if nt : (leaves T).Nodup then
  bump ((nodupTreeMeter S).work+1) <|
  if ns : (leaves S).Nodup then
  bump ((partitionTreeMeter T X Y).work+1) <|
  if hpT : partitionCheck (leaves T) [X,Y]=true then
  bump ((partitionTreeMeter S X Y).work+1) <|
  if hpS : partitionCheck (leaves S) [X,Y]=true then
  bump 2 <|
  if nonroot : p≠[] then
  bump ((subtreeMeter S p).work+1) <|
  match (generalizing := false) source : subtree S p with
  | none => ⟨none,1⟩
  | some u =>
    bump ((leavesMeter u).work+(permMeter (leaves u) X).work+1) <|
    if labels : (leaves u).Perm X then
    bump ((incidentMeter T X).work+1) <|
    match (generalizing := false) boundary : incident T X with
    | [q] =>
      let x := X.headD 0
      let y := Y.headD 0
      let L := leaves T++leaves S
      let rho := labelMax L+1
      let gamma := labelMax L+2
      bump ((leavesMeter T).work+(leavesMeter S).work+(leaves T).length+
        2*(maxMeter L).work+8+
        (meterRestrict X T).work+(meterRestrict X S).work+
        (meterRestrict Y T).work+(meterRestrict Y S).work+
        (markedMeter T X y rho).work+(markedMeter S X y rho).work+
        (markedMeter T Y x gamma).work+(markedMeter S Y x gamma).work+8) <|
      match (generalizing := false) htx : restrict X T, hsx : restrict X S,
            hty : restrict Y T, hsy : restrict Y S,
            hMXT : marked T X y rho, hMXS : marked S X y rho,
            hMYT : marked T Y x gamma, hMYS : marked S Y x gamma with
      | some tx,some sx,some ty,some sy,some mxT,some mxS,some myT,some myS =>

ofProps.literalProps_definition:
def LiteralProps (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex)
 (R : BottomData) (C : Tree) (qa ub : RMAF.Vertex) : Prop :=
 properPair T S=true ∧
 subtree S R.w=some (bottom R.sa R.sc R.sb R.a R.b d.c R.X) ∧
 (∃ i∈HardParent.vertices T, CherryAt T i R.a R.b ∨ CherryAt T i R.b R.a) ∧
 (cuts S R.a R.b).length=2 ∧
 (∀ z∈leaves T, z∈leaves C ↔ z∉leaves R.X ∧ z≠d.c) ∧
 R.b∈leaves C ∧ d.c∉leaves C ∧
 LeafAt T qa R.a ∧ LeafAt T ub R.b ∧ LeafAt T u d.c ∧
 (incident T (leaves R.X)=[v,u] ∨ incident T (leaves R.X)=[u,v]) ∧
 v.dropLast∈minimalVertices (leaves R.X) T ∧ u.dropLast∈minimalVertices (leaves R.X) T ∧
 v∉minimalVertices (leaves R.X) T ∧ u∉minimalVertices (leaves R.X) T ∧
 subtreeLabels S d.badArc=leaves R.X ∧ EndpointOrder a b R.a R.b
ofProps.consumer_premises: core : subtree T v=some C and full LiteralProps T S a b d u v R C qa ub. The actual caller must test them.

buildOneMeter.literal_body:
def buildOneMeter (fee : LiteralCall→Nat) (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection)
 (u v : RMAF.Vertex) (R : BottomData) : Measured (Option (LiteralGeometry T S)) :=
 bump ((subtreeMeter T v).work+(leafAddressMeter T R.a).work+(leafAddressMeter T R.b).work+5) <|
 match hc:subtree T v,leafAddress? T R.a,leafAddress? T R.b with
 | some C,some qa,some ub=>
   bump (fee ⟨R,C,qa,ub,d,u,v⟩+1) <|
   if h:LiteralProps T S a b d u v R C qa ub then ⟨some (ofProps hc h),1⟩ else ⟨none,1⟩
 | _,_,_=>⟨none,1⟩
